concerns.text: The plan targets NIST-IR-8200 as the primary source but explicitly acknowledges in the 'Verified Sources' section that 'NO verified source found' and 'no verified dataset URL exists for this specific materials science task'. The plan proceeds to implement ingestion logic for a dataset that is not in the verified list, creating a high probability of immediate pipeline failure (DataInsufficientError) before any modeling occurs. The methodology assumes a programmatic interface exists for a dataset the system has already flagged as unverified/unavailable.

The plan assumes a dataset size of '~500-2000 records' and '~20-50 alloy designations' without citing a specific source or verified dataset that contains this volume of joint (composition, environment, corrosion) data. The research.md admits the verified list only contains medical datasets. Relying on an unverified NIST-IR-8200 access pattern that may not exist violates the 'Verified Accuracy' constitution principle and renders the compute plan infeasible if the data cannot be retrieved.
